# ⚡ DG CommandItems

**Bind any command to any item - the modern, free way.**

A clean, modern replacement for older command-item plugins that have stopped getting updates. Supports **Minecraft 1.21.x and 26.1.x** on Paper / Spigot.

---

## ✨ What it does

Right-click an item, run a command. Left-click an item, run a command. Shift-click an item, run a command. You get the idea.

## 🔥 Features

- **Full GUI editor** - create and edit items visually with `/dgci`, no config editing required
- **Sound & particle pickers** - browse 36 popular sounds and 35 particles in dedicated GUIs, with live preview before you commit
- **TrueOP execution** - runs player commands with full OP perms, fixes EssentialsX `/fly`, `/heal`, `/god` issues that plague other plugins
- **Per-item cooldowns** with bypass permission
- **Click type filtering** - right, left, shift, or any combination
- **Player *and* console commands** - run as the player, or as console
- **Consume on use** toggle (single-use scrolls, multi-use wands, etc.)
- **Per-item permissions**
- **PlaceholderAPI support** in commands and messages
- **Hex color codes** (`&#RRGGBB`) in names, lore, and messages
- **Custom Model Data** for resource packs
- **Strict OP-only access** to `/dgci` - bypasses LuckPerms etc. so only real OPs can create items

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Drop the jar in your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart the server
3. Hold any item, run `/dgci`
4. Click the Nether Star, then configure name, lore, click types, commands, and pick a sound/particle
5. Click Save

That's it.

## 📜 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/dgci` | Open the GUI |
| `/dgci give <id> [player] [amount]` | Give an item |
| `/dgci list` / `info <id>` / `delete <id>` | Manage items |
| `/dgci reload` | Reload config |

Aliases: `/citem`, `/ci`, `/commanditems`

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `dgcommanditems.use` | `true` | Use command items |
| `dgcommanditems.use.<itemid>` | - | Per-item access (optional) |
| `dgcommanditems.bypass.cooldown` | `op` | Bypass cooldowns |

> **Note:** Access to `/dgci` is restricted to real OPs (`Player#isOp()`) - this is intentional, since command items can run as console.
